The '''All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1921''' was the 35th staging of the [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]], the [[Gaelic Athletic Association]]'s premier [[inter county|inter-county]] [[hurling]] tournament. The championship ran from 8 May 1921 to 4 March 1923.

[[Dublin GAA|Dublin]] were the [[1920 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|defending champions]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.rte.ie/centuryireland/articles/dublin-victorious-in-deferred-all-ireland-hurling-final|title=Dublin victorious in deferred All-Ireland hurling final|publisher=Century Ireland|date=|accessdate=17 October 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.limerickleader.ie/sport/100th-anniversary-of-limerick-duo-winning-all-ireland-hurling-title-with-dublin-8024509|title=100th anniversary of Limerick duo winning All-Ireland hurling title with Dublin|publisher=Limerick Live|date=12 December 2020|accessdate=17 October 2026}}</ref>

The [[1921 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship final|All-Ireland final]] was played at [[Croke Park]] in [[Dublin]] on 4 March 1923 between [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] and Dublin, in what was their [[Dublin–Limerick hurling rivalry#All-time results|first ever championship meeting]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.dublingaa.ie/news/senior-hurlers-strive-to-get-the-better-of-limerick|title=Senior hurlers strive to get the better of Limerick|publisher=Dublin GAA website|date=9 July 2015|accessdate=17 October 2026}}</ref> Limerick won the match by 8–05 to 3–02 to claim their third All-Ireland title overall and a first title in [[1918 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|three years]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.independent.ie/sport/gaa/hurling/frank-roches-all-ireland-hurling-final-diary/a/134606298.html|title=Frank Roche’s All-Ireland Hurling final diary |publisher=Irish Independent|date=20 August 2021|accessdate=17 October 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.irishexaminer.com/sport/gaa/arid-40239800.html|title=Limerick launch hooped jersey to mark the first Liam MacCarthy Cup winners|publisher=Irish Examiner|date=7 March 2021|accessdate=17 October 2026}}</ref>
